authoring_environment.method: The existing v4 measured-contact path aligns the source work branch to the evaluated Meshy left-index skin, solves the right forearm IK target from actual thumb-surface gaps, and bakes the two-arm hold into Meshy-local pose bases. The branch is parented to mixamorig:LeftHand with matrix_world preserved. Work samples add a restrained right-hand stroke along the measured line between both contact points. The seven frozen clips apply hierarchical local-rotation deltas from the sampled source work reference onto this target hold, retaining Meshy rest offsets and unit scales; only explicit Hips translation deltas transfer. Source Root remains excluded.
